title: TikTok Shop Scraper Input
description: Provide one or more TikTok Shop product URLs. The actor extracts price, variants, seller, sold count, ratings, images, and (optionally) reviews. Search/shop/category modes are on the v0.2 roadmap.

productUrls.title: Product URLs
productUrls.description: Direct TikTok Shop product page URLs to scrape, one per line. Accepts shop.tiktok.com/view/product/<id> and shop.tiktok.com/<region>/pdp/<slug>/<id>. Returns full product details + variants + seller. Multiple URLs run in parallel.

includeReviews.title: Include reviews
includeReviews.description: When true, scrapes reviews for each product (capped by maxReviewsPerProduct). Adds $0.001 per review to the cost. Defaults to false. Set to true only when review text/ratings are needed downstream.

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Cap on reviews extracted per product when includeReviews=true (1-1000). Reviews are returned newest-first. Defaults to 30. Ignored when includeReviews=false.

proxyConfiguration.title: Restricted access control
proxyConfiguration.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
